# Fallon Scott

> Fractional COO and operations architect. Simplifies, streamlines, and connects how a founder-led business runs end to end, then safely and strategically architects the systems that make it fundable, scalable, and sellable. Architect before automate: audit and optimize the process before layering on AI or automation, so you never document or pay to automate waste. CPA, Lean Six Sigma, ex-KPMG and Delta Air Lines Internal Audit. Co-founder of Makenzie House (11× revenue in 12 months).

- [Home](https://fallonscott.com/): Overview of services, packages, story, and ways to engage.
- [About](https://fallonscott.com/about.html): Full career chronology — KPMG (2010–2012) → Delta Internal Audit (2012–2015) → sales/marketing leadership scaling a 6,000-person team (2015–2019) → F28 Agency, 60+ engagements streamlining workflows and connecting operations end to end (2019–present) → Makenzie House co-founder, 11× revenue (2022–present).
- [SOP Suite](https://fallonscott.com/sop-suite.html): Self-serve digital product, $998 launch. Three bundles plus walkthrough videos, fillable templates, masterlist, prioritization plan, optimization calculator.
- [Speaking](https://fallonscott.com/speaking.html): Keynotes, workshops, panels, podcast features.

## Ways to work together

Three doors at the top level:
- Do it yourself — The SOP Suite. Self-serve digital product. $998 launch (regular $1,497).
- Diagnose it — fixed-scope diagnostics, $1,500 each, credited toward an engagement:
  - Right People, Right Seats Diagnostic — role + seat audit, people and role gaps.
  - Automate the Admin Diagnostic — manual-task and automation audit with a risk lens.
- Fix it with me — The Ops Partner engagement. Four operational models inside it (Assessment, Acceleration, Transformation, Operational Leadership). Everything is scoped after a discovery call; pricing follows what the business actually needs. Rough shape: a targeted Acceleration runs about 4–12 weeks, a full Transformation about 3–6 months.

Only public prices: The SOP Suite ($998) and the diagnostics ($1,500 each). Engagement pricing is scoped after a discovery call.
